newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-David Jones appoints Wilkinson CEO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-David Jones appoints Wilkinson CEO.

text.p: David Jones Ltd said on Wednesday it has appointed Peter Wilkinson chief executive officer of the company.
Wilkinson is currently managing director of Just Jeans Holdings Ltd.
The appointment of Wilkinson follows the surprise resignation of former David Jones chief executive Chris Tideman on Monday, after three years with the company.

"We are delighted to announce Peter's appointment as he brings a high degree of Australian retail experience to David Jones at both management and operational levels," David Jones chairman Richard Warburton said in a statement.

"We are looking forward to Peter joining the team and are confident he will be a catalyst to drive the company forward," Warburton said. Wilkinson is to join the upmarket department store chain at the beginning of April.

Commenting on his appointment, Wilkinson said: "David Jones is an icon in Australian retailing and I am eager to work with the board, staff and suppliers to consolidate the company's position as the country's leading upmarket department store and to increase shareholder value."
Wilkinson was formerly managing director of Coles Myer Ltd's Myer Grace department store chain before he started with Just Jeans in January 1996.
David Jones earlier reported a 50 percent fall in net profit to A$22.34 million for the 26 weeks ended January 25, 1997.
Retail analysts said Tideman's exit followed a series of disappointing results since the company's refloating on the Australian Stock Exchnage in November 1995.
Over the same period Australian retail sales have been sluggish.
David Jones shares closed three cents lower at A$1.71, while Just Jeans shares ended five cents up at A$1.65.
